purpose: Verify that the system opens a dedicated course workspace when an authorized user selects a registered/assigned course.
preconditions: User is enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to course C101.
action_or_input: User selects course C101 from their course list.
expected_result: The dedicated course workspace for C101 opens successfully.

purpose: Verify that the course home page displays the course syllabus, schedule, instructor(s), and TA(s).
preconditions: Authorized user has opened the course workspace for C101, which has configured syllabus, schedule, instructor(s), and TA(s).
action_or_input: User navigates to the course home page.
expected_result: Course syllabus, schedule, instructor(s), and TA(s) are all displayed on the course home page.

purpose: Verify that access to a course workspace is restricted to users enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to that specific course.
preconditions: User is not enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to course C101.
action_or_input: User attempts to open or access the course workspace for C101.
expected_result: Access is denied; workspace is not opened and an authorization error is returned.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can configure the course workspace for courses assigned to that Faculty member.
preconditions: Faculty member F1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 configures the course workspace settings for C101.
expected_result: Workspace configuration changes are successfully saved and applied to C101.

purpose: Verify that Faculty cannot configure a course workspace for a course not assigned to that Faculty member.
preconditions: Faculty member F2 is not assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F2 attempts to configure the course workspace settings for C101.
expected_result: System rejects the action with an authorization error; configuration remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can edit and publish course details for an assigned course workspace.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 edits course details and triggers the publish action.
expected_result: Updated course details are successfully saved and published in the C101 course workspace.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can add course materials as files, links, or notes.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 uploads a material file, adds an external resource link, and adds a text note in C101.
expected_result: All three material types (file, link, and note) are successfully added to course materials.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can organize course materials into modules or weekly sections.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101; materials have been uploaded.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 assigns uploaded materials to defined modules and weekly sections.
expected_result: Course materials are organized and presented according to the specified modules or weekly sections.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can configure a future release date for course material.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 adds course material and specifies a future release date and time.
expected_result: System captures the future release date and designates the material as scheduled.

purpose: Verify that scheduled course material is made published and available to authorized course users when the release time is reached.
preconditions: Course material in C101 has a scheduled future release timestamp; current time reaches or exceeds the release timestamp.
action_or_input: An authorized course user accesses the materials view in C101.
expected_result: Material status becomes published and the material is accessible to authorized course users.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view published course materials for their registered course in read-only form.
preconditions: Student S1 is registered in course C101; published course materials exist in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 navigates to view course materials in C101.
expected_result: Published course materials are displayed in read-only form with no authoring or edit options available.

purpose: Verify that scheduled-not-yet-released materials are not exposed to Students prior to release date.
preconditions: Course material in C101 has a future scheduled release date; current time is before that date; Student S1 is registered in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 accesses course materials in C101.
expected_result: The scheduled-not-yet-released material is withheld and not visible or accessible to Student S1.

purpose: Verify that a TA can view published course materials for the assigned course in read-only form.
preconditions: Teaching Assistant TA1 is assigned to course C101; published course materials exist.
action_or_input: TA1 navigates to course materials in C101.
expected_result: Published course materials are displayed to TA1 in read-only form.

purpose: Verify that an Observer can view published course materials for the linked course in read-only form.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to course C101; published course materials exist.
action_or_input: Observer O1 navigates to course materials in C101.
expected_result: Published course materials are displayed to Observer O1 in read-only form.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can post a course-wide announcement for an assigned course.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 drafts and posts an announcement for course C101.
expected_result: Announcement is successfully created and posted to course C101.

purpose: Verify that a TA can post a course-wide announcement where permitted by Faculty for the course.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to course C101 and announcement posting permission is enabled for TA1 in C101.
action_or_input: TA1 drafts and posts a course-wide announcement for C101.
expected_result: Announcement is successfully created and posted to course C101.

purpose: Verify that a TA cannot post a course-wide announcement when not permitted for that course.
preconditions: TA2 is assigned to course C101 and announcement posting permission is not granted to TA2.
action_or_input: TA2 attempts to post an announcement for C101.
expected_result: Action is denied with an authorization error; announcement is not posted.

purpose: Verify that the system timestamps each posted course announcement.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 posts a course announcement in C101 at time T1.
expected_result: The posted announcement records and displays an accurate posting timestamp matching T1.

purpose: Verify that a posted course announcement is visible to all users enrolled in or linked to that course.
preconditions: An announcement is posted in C101; Student S1 is enrolled, TA1 is assigned, and Observer O1 is linked to C101.
action_or_input: Student S1, TA1, and Observer O1 independently access the announcements view in C101.
expected_result: The announcement is visible to Student S1, TA1, and Observer O1.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can create an assignment for an assigned course.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates a new assignment for course C101.
expected_result: Assignment record is created in course C101.

purpose: Verify that the system captures assignment due date, instructions, submission type, and points possible.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is creating an assignment in C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 inputs due date, instructions, submission type (file/text/link), and points possible, then saves.
expected_result: System stores all four attributes (due date, instructions, submission type, points possible) accurately.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can edit an existing assignment.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101; an assignment exists in C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates the assignment instructions and points possible, then saves.
expected_result: Assignment configuration is updated and saved with the new values.

purpose: Verify that an assignment remains in Draft state until Faculty publishes it.
preconditions: Faculty F1 creates a new assignment in C101 without triggering publish; Student S1 is registered in C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 checks assignment state; Student S1 views the assignment list.
expected_result: Assignment remains in Draft state and is not visible to Student S1.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can publish an assignment.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to C101; an assignment in C101 is in Draft state.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 triggers the publish action on the draft assignment.
expected_result: Assignment state successfully transitions from Draft to Published.

purpose: Verify that a published assignment is withheld from Students until its configured release date/time.
preconditions: Assignment in C101 is published with a future release date/time; current time is before the release time; Student S1 is registered in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 views the assignments list for C101.
expected_result: The published assignment is withheld and is not visible to Student S1.

purpose: Verify that an assignment becomes available to Students when the configured release time is reached.
preconditions: Assignment in C101 is published with a release timestamp; current time reaches or exceeds the configured release timestamp; Student S1 is registered in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 views assignments in C101.
expected_result: The assignment becomes visible and accessible to Student S1.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view and download an assignment after it has been released for their registered course.
preconditions: Assignment in C101 is released; Student S1 is registered in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 views assignment details and initiates download of assignment content.
expected_result: Assignment instructions/details are displayed and the assignment download completes successfully.

purpose: Verify that a Student can submit assignment work as file, text, or link according to the assignment's configured submission type.
preconditions: Assignments A1 (configured for file), A2 (configured for text), and A3 (configured for link) are released in C101; Student S1 is registered in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 submits a file to A1, text content to A2, and a URL link to A3.
expected_result: System accepts and stores the submission work matching the configured type for each assignment.

purpose: Verify that the system accepts and records a Student submission made before the assignment due date.
preconditions: Assignment in C101 has a due date in the future; Student S1 is registered in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 submits required work prior to the due date.
expected_result: System accepts and records the submission with an on-time timestamp.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view their own assignment submission history.
preconditions: Student S1 has submitted work for an assignment in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 navigates to view their submission history for the assignment.
expected_result: Student S1 views their own submission history including submitted content and submission timestamp.

purpose: Verify that a Student cannot view another student's assignment submission history.
preconditions: Students S1 and S2 are registered in C101; Student S2 has submitted work for an assignment.
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to access Student S2's submission history.
expected_result: Access is denied; Student S1 cannot view Student S2's submission history.

purpose: Verify that the system displays the Student's own submission status as submitted, late, or missing where applicable.
preconditions: Student S1 is registered in C101 with assignments in submitted and unsubmitted states.
action_or_input: Student S1 views their submission status across assignments in C101.
expected_result: System accurately displays submission status ('submitted' or 'missing') for Student S1's assignments.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can grade an individual Student submission by entering points and feedback.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to C101; Student S1 has submitted work for an assignment in C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 opens S1's submission, inputs points and feedback, and saves.
expected_result: Entered points and feedback are saved on S1's submission record.

purpose: Verify that a TA can grade an individual Student submission for the assigned course by entering points and feedback.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to C101; Student S1 has submitted work for an assignment in C101.
action_or_input: TA1 opens S1's submission, inputs points and feedback, and saves.
expected_result: Entered points and feedback are saved on S1's submission record.

purpose: Verify that the system records the identity of the Faculty member or TA who performs a grading action.
preconditions: Faculty F1 and TA1 perform separate grading actions on submissions in C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 and TA1 submit their respective grading entries.
expected_result: System records and attributes each grading action to the specific actor (Faculty F1 or TA1).

purpose: Verify that the system keeps grade and feedback in Draft state until release.
preconditions: A grading action is performed and saved by Faculty or TA for a submission in C101 without release.
action_or_input: User inspects the state of the saved grade and feedback.
expected_result: Grade and feedback status is Draft.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents a Student from viewing a grade or feedback before it is released.
preconditions: Student S1's submission has grade and feedback saved in Draft state; Student S1 is registered in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 views their assignment submission and grades page.
expected_result: Draft grade and feedback are hidden and not visible to Student S1.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can release draft grades and feedback to Students.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to C101; draft grades and feedback exist for an assignment.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 triggers the release grades action.
expected_result: Draft grades and feedback transition to Released state and become available to applicable Students.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view their own grade and feedback after release.
preconditions: Grade and feedback for Student S1 have been released in C101; Student S1 is registered in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 accesses their assignment submission view.
expected_result: Released points and feedback are visible to Student S1.

purpose: Verify that a Student cannot view another student's released grade and feedback.
preconditions: Students S1 and S2 are registered in C101; Student S2's grade has been released.
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to view Student S2's released grade and feedback.
expected_result: Access is denied; Student S1 cannot view Student S2's grade or feedback.

purpose: Verify that released grade and feedback are presented to the Student in read-only form.
preconditions: Student S1 is viewing their own released grade and feedback in C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to edit, alter, or update the displayed grade or feedback.
expected_result: Grade and feedback fields are strictly read-only; edit attempts are rejected.

purpose: Verify that the system records who made the change when a released grade is changed.
preconditions: Grade for a submission in C101 is in Released state; Faculty F1 edits the released points/feedback.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 saves the modified grade.
expected_result: System logs the grade change and records Faculty F1 as the actor who made the change.

purpose: Verify that the system records when the change was made when a released grade is changed.
preconditions: Grade for a submission in C101 is in Released state; Faculty F1 edits the released grade at timestamp T2.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 saves the modified grade.
expected_result: System logs the grade change and records timestamp T2 for when the modification occurred.

purpose: Verify that a TA can view course details, published materials, and announcements for the assigned course.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: TA1 navigates to course details, published materials, and announcements in C101.
expected_result: Course details, published materials, and announcements for C101 are displayed to TA1.

purpose: Verify that a TA can view Student submissions for the assigned course.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to course C101; student submissions exist for assignments in C101.
action_or_input: TA1 opens the submissions list for an assignment in C101.
expected_result: Student submissions for the assigned course are accessible and visible to TA1.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents a TA from creating or editing assignments.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: TA1 attempts to create a new assignment or edit an existing assignment in C101.
expected_result: Action is denied with an authorization error; TA cannot create or edit assignments.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents a TA from creating or editing course materials.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: TA1 attempts to upload, create, or edit course materials in C101.
expected_result: Action is denied with an authorization error; TA cannot create or edit course materials.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents a TA from modifying course structure.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to course C101.
action_or_input: TA1 attempts to create, reorder, or delete modules or weekly sections in C101.
expected_result: Action is denied with an authorization error; TA cannot modify course structure.

purpose: Verify that an Observer can view course details, published materials, and announcements for the linked course in read-only form.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to course C101.
action_or_input: Observer O1 accesses course details, published materials, and announcements in C101.
expected_result: Course details, published materials, and announcements are displayed to Observer O1 in read-only form.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents an Observer from viewing individual Student submissions.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to course C101; student submissions exist in C101.
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts to access individual student submissions in C101.
expected_result: Access is denied; Observer O1 cannot view individual Student submissions.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents an Observer from viewing grades or any other Student-specific data.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to course C101; student grades and student-specific data exist in C101.
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts to view student grades or student-specific records in C101.
expected_result: Access is denied; Observer O1 cannot view student grades or any student-specific data.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents an Observer from performing write actions anywhere in the module.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to course C101.
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts to perform write actions (e.g., posting announcements, uploading materials, creating assignments, submitting work, grading).
expected_result: All write actions are denied with an authorization error; module data remains unmodified.
